data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'Mīrān' meaning 'gentle' or 'radiant'. In Islamic culture, it symbolizes the peaceful and gentle nature of a woman, often associated with the qualities of kindness and compassion. The name Meeran carries the meaning “Gentle, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Meeran usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
